cohort: The study included 286 women with term pregnancies complicated by isolated polyhydramnios who received prophylactic uterotonics (carbetocin, oxytocin, or oxytocin-ergometrine) immediately after placental delivery at a tertiary obstetric center.
finding: Carbetocin was associated with significantly smaller drops in hemoglobin and hematocrit, lower estimated blood loss, and more favorable shock index values compared to oxytocin and oxytocin-ergometrine, indicating superior prophylactic control of postpartum hemorrhage in women with isolated polyhydramnios.
mod_finding: Carbetocin's advantages in PPH prevention were consistent across both cesarean and vaginal (primiparous and multiparous) deliveries.
